verdict.rationale: Skills can carry a description saying when to use them, and Claude loads them automatically when it judges them relevant. Plugins can also bundle 'hooks' alongside skills. However, this is relevance-based triggering, not explicit event→action rules, and several users report auto-triggering is hit or miss in practice. The hooks are only named, never documented here as an event-rule mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit event-driven rule definitions (event types, conditions, actions), documentation of how plugin hooks fire on events, and reliable, independently corroborated automatic triggering.
